rv.q: It begins in 1979 with the disappearance of 17-year-old Hanako (Kirsty Rider) during a storm. At first, Japanese authorities assume the girl has been murdered, then that she was drowned by the great wave.

But her performance is a little inconsistent. Even though the ambiguity of the setup is tantalising – where is she? – sometimes it feels like a naturalistic one-to-one conversation, sometimes like a rehearsed speech.
I feel like my job is more about telling people who already have tickets how lucky they are.
